title: Membership and acceptance at the configuration bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be a language of binary strings, and let $s\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every input $x$ there is a time $T$ such that $N$ halts on every branch by time $T$, uses at most $s(|x|)$ work-tape cells on every branch of length $T$, and $x\in L$ exactly when $N$ accepts $x$ within $T$ steps. Then, for every binary string $x$, $x\in L$ if and only if $N$ accepts $x$ within $3(\lvert Q\rvert+1)(|x|+2)3^{k(2s(|x|)+1)}(2s(|x|)+1)^k$ steps, where $Q$ is the state set of $N$ and $k$ is its number of work tapes.
